title: Sunset sailing with dinner
text: The crew (captain Luigi, chef Saray, and deckhand Lucie) were knowledgeable, friendly, and provided an enjoyable sailing.  Although, the weather that evening was a bit cooler, they provided blankets to those who needed them.  We also booked a dinner with the sailing and chef Saray prepared a delicious meal according to our choosing at the time of booking.  The guitarist on deck played soothing music in the background. Overall, we had an enjoyable sailing and we would consider it again!
author: Wael_S

title: Brilliant experience, loved by all.
text: Really lovely way to spend a couple of hours with friends and dinner. We were a group of 7 and there were 2 other guests who we quickly made friends with. The crew of 3 were great and we wanted for nothing - lovely 3 course meal and plenty of drinks. We also booked the optional guitar player who was brilliant (see video) and really added to the ambience. Special shout out to Isabelle who kept me iodated before and after the event. Highly recommended.
author: David186336
